prompt: Camera on the dirt, tilted steeply up through a very wide lens, at a crash-strewn oval track at night in the 1920s. A young Black racing mechanic of about 24, lean face, high cheekbones, clean-shaven, oil smeared on one cheek, leather cap pushed back, stands over us, three-quarter, chin up and grinning through the note, his face lit lilac-white from a floodlight tower. Behind him and small, a stripped roadster hot rod burns amber on its side beside a snapped wooden rail, and one wooden wheel lies in the dirt. Dust hangs in the floodlight beams. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
